title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Full descriptions validated on LinkedIn. Scores measure skill and domain fit.
latest_update: Latest update: September 21, 2026 — 45 mandatory passes completed; 5 current postings fully validated, including 1 pipeline match.

notes_sections.heading: September 21 latest run
items: 45 mandatory passes completed: 14 Canada-remote title phrases, 11 remote-hub discovery passes, and 20 hybrid title/city passes across Ottawa, Kingston, Cornwall, and Montréal. All used LinkedIn's reliable Past 24 hours filter because its attempted 48-hour parameter rendered as Past week.

Best current match: Syntax — Senior Platform Engineer (SRE), AI Solutions. The fresh repost matches Marc's existing Applied pipeline row by company and exact role, so its status remains Applied. Azure, Terraform, GitOps, observability, incident response, AI-assisted engineering and automation align well; deep Kubernetes/CNCF and Backstage ownership remain the main gap.

ClearGov — Senior DevOps Engineer: strong developer enablement, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, incident response and AI-guardrail alignment. The decisive mismatch is deep hands-on AWS architecture; compensation is CAD $110K–$140K, above the remote floor but below the aspirational target.

Sage Recruiting client — Staff Platform Engineer: exceptional pay at CAD $210K–$260K plus equity, but the role explicitly demands production Go, deep AWS, and extensive Kubernetes cluster operations, making it a stretch despite strong ownership, Terraform, reliability and AI-workflow overlap.

LinkedIn read-only audit: Kingston and Cornwall returned zero with the Hybrid filter. Required unfiltered reruns were completed; the visible results were Canada-remote roles rather than local hybrid candidates. No CAPTCHA, checkpoint, or login loss occurred.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 latest run
items: Best new match: Hunter Bond — Platform Engineer. Montréal hybrid with CAD $180K base, strong Linux/Python/Terraform/Ansible/Puppet/Kubernetes alignment; office cadence is not disclosed and must be confirmed at two days/week or less.

Strong Azure contract lead: Raas Infotek — DevOps Architect. Excellent Azure, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD and reliability alignment; the poster-added 8+ years Terraform and 6+ years Python requirements are the main risk, and no rate was stated.
CANARIE is a strong senior platform role in Ottawa, but the CAD $125K–$169K range partly falls below the hybrid floor and the cadence is undisclosed.
Elastic is an exact pipeline match already applied through Built In on Sep 18; the fresh LinkedIn posting confirms CAD $138.3K–$185.9K and active hiring.

Excluded after full validation: Alpen Labs (must be based in the United States), QUANTEAM (four Montréal office days/week), Aptiv/Wind River (CAD $95K–$120K hybrid), and TELUS Health (CAD $49K–$89.7K). Chainlink remains scored low because deep Kubernetes internals/Operators, production AWS and Go are core requirements.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 rerun
items: Best fresh match: Syntax Senior Platform Engineer (SRE), AI Solutions. Azure, Terraform, GitOps, observability, incident response and automation align well; deep Kubernetes/CNCF and Backstage ownership are the main gaps.
StackAdapt is well paid and remote, but requires strong production AWS plus significant Kubernetes node and deployment-pipeline ownership.
Chainlink Labs is globally remote and platform-focused, but explicitly requires deep Kubernetes internals, Operators, production AWS and Go.
Stripe was freshly reposted and remains retained at 4/10; its five-year full-stack minimum is still the decisive mismatch.

GitLab's Engineering Manager result was excluded because the profile does not support current engineering people-management scope. Repario and Avenue Code were not scored because their full eligibility/requirements could not be established during this pass.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 decisions
items: Syntax and StackAdapt: Marc applied to both Sep 18 with tailored resumes and cover letters; recorded as Applied in applications.md.
GSPANN Technologies (AI Observability & Platform Engineer): skipped by Marc's explicit call — not pursued.
Undisclosed — Senior Cloud Platform Engineer and Stripe — Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services: both confirmed by Marc as no longer accepting applications; relabeled Expired.

notes_sections.heading: Validation limits
items: Boundary: the 14 default phrase families were covered through public discovery queries, plus one authenticated Canada-remote LinkedIn pass with the past-two-days URL filter. LinkedIn displayed “Past week” despite the requested 48-hour parameter.
Three new postings were fully validated on LinkedIn; no employer-site recovery was needed. Four additional visible results were excluded or left unvalidated.
The per-hub and per-city result grids were not exhaustively paginated; no eligible Kingston or Cornwall posting surfaced. Search activity was read-only.

method: Authenticated, strictly read-only LinkedIn search completed September 21, 2026. Passes attempted/completed: 45/45 — 14 Canada-remote phrase passes, 11 remote-hub passes, and 20 reachable-city hybrid passes, each independently rendered with Past 24 hours. Up to seven visible results per pass were reviewed before deduplication. Kingston and Cornwall Hybrid-filter zeroes were rerun without the workplace filter as required. Five current postings were validated from accessible full descriptions and scored; five additional plausible postings are listed as inaccessible. Syntax matched an existing Applied row by company and exact role. Historical rows and prior pipeline decisions remain preserved below.
